title: The Last Window
overview: When Charles J. Connick Associates closed their doors in 1986, they left a legacy of 15,000 stained glass windows in more than 5000 churches, libraries and other public buildings. Founded on the principles of a medieval craft guild, this Boston studio was closely allied with Ralph Adams Cram, Dean of the Gothic revival in American architecture, and in it's heyday, between 1920 and 1950, employed and trained scores of artisans. The Last Window, narrated by Jonathan Fairbanks, Curator of American Decorative Arts Museum of Fine Arts Boston, follows the studio's final commission from design to installation; the artisans' commentary establishes the historical, aesthetic, and social context in which they work. Many examples of Connick windows are included, taking the film outside the studio to show the contrast between the workers' relationship with the art and that of the patrons and users.

Although he is hailed as a champion and his name is recognized by many as a reliable boxer, deep in his heart, this is not the path he desires. Battling sub-zero temperatures, relentless fatigue and over 2,400 kilometres, the challenge pushes him far beyond his physical limits.  But this is more than a film about running. As the kilometres mount, Lachie and his wife navigate the emotional uncertainty of IVF, transforming a record-breaking feat into a deeply human story of hope, heartbreak and resilience.  Filmed with an intimate, observational approach by a minimal crew embedded in the experience, States of Mind places audiences alongside every step, revealing that true endurance isn't just about what we can achieve, but how we keep moving forward through life's greatest challenges.

overview: The treatment for head and neck cancer depends on the type, location, size, and stage of the cancer. Your doctor will review your biopsy, scans, and other test results before deciding whether you may need surgery, radiation therapy, chemotherapy, or a combination of treatments.  Surgery may be recommended when the cancer can be removed safely. A head and neck cancer surgeon may also plan reconstruction when needed to help maintain important functions such as speaking, eating, and swallowing.  Radiation therapy may be given after surgery to reduce the chance of cancer coming back, or it may be used as the main treatment in some cases. Chemotherapy may also be used with radiation or other treatments depending on the cancer and its stage. title: Don't Take Chances
overview: This film serves as a sobering cautionary tale regarding workplace safety, emphasizing that industrial accidents are rarely the result of equipment failure alone, but rather the consequence of human thoughtlessness and lapses in concentration. Through graphic testimonials and interviews with victims who have suffered life-altering injuries—including amputations and permanent disability—the film illustrates the long-term physical, emotional, and economic devastation that follows a split-second mistake. While highlighting the importance of personal protective equipment and rigorous safety protocols, the narrative ultimately argues that machinery is only as safe as the person operating it. It concludes with a powerful appeal to workers to remain perpetually vigilant, asserting that the only defense against the inherent dangers of the workplace is a constant, proactive commitment to safety-conscious thinking.

overview: "Football is synonymous with childhood and the neighborhood," asserts an interviewee in ‘La soledad del jugador de banda’ (‘The Loneliness of the Left Wing-Back’). Through the analogy between football and cinema, this documentary addresses the social, community, and identity-shaping power of the sport. Set against the backdrop of the working-class neighborhoods in southern Madrid, it reveals the desire to make films and the opportunities available to the working class to do so. Thus emerges a metacinematic narrative to reflect on form and the implications of creators and their desires.  Furthermore, it explores how the communities built around football interact with the "other"—with the marginalized—through homophobia and machismo in sports. The filmmaker lays himself bare to tell his story as a fan, a player, a queer individual, and an aspiring filmmaker.
tagline: Why would you love football?

title: The Dangers of Drugs
overview: This 70s Soviet film presents a stark and emotional portrayal of drug addiction, particularly among youth, highlighting its devastating psychological, physical, and social consequences. It begins with a story of a girl who takes her life after heavy drug use, using this as a gateway to discuss how addiction often starts with curiosity or a desire to escape. Personal testimonies illustrate how quickly experimentation can turn into dependency, as users seek artificial ways to cope with emotional pain or social pressure. The film explains the science behind addiction, detailing how substances hijack the brain’s chemistry, leading to psychological dependence, physical addiction, and increasing tolerance. As addiction deepens, the initial euphoria disappears, replaced by a desperate need to use just to feel “normal.” Ultimately, the film underscores that drug addiction is not only a personal tragedy but a societal crisis—one that affects families, communities, and nations alike.

overview: To shortlist puzzle parking system manufacturers, start by checking their experience in designing and installing parking systems for projects similar to yours. title: How much space does a puzzle parking system need?
original_title: How much space does a puzzle parking system need?
overview: A Puzzle Parking System needs much less space than a conventional parking layout because it uses both vertical and horizontal space to park multiple vehicles. The exact space required depends on the number of parking spaces, vehicle size, platform dimensions, available height, and the type of puzzle car parking system selected. A typical system may require around 25–35 sq. ft. of footprint per car, but the actual requirement can vary based on the design and site conditions.  For a puzzle type parking system, the available height is also important because vehicles are arranged on multiple levels. A hydraulic puzzle parking system may need additional space for its lifting and movement mechanism, while an automated puzzle parking system can be designed according to the available building area and parking capacity.

overview: Goutam Halder takes center stage with his epic performance of Meghnad Badh Kavya. Regarded as a central work in Bengali literature, this masterpiece is Dutt's greatest literary achievement and the finest epic in Bengali literature, often considered one of the greatest works of world literature. Meghnad Badh Kavya is based on the demise of Meghnad (a.k.a. Indrajit), son of Ravana, the king of Lanka, as narrated in the classic Sanskrit epic Ramayana.  Michael Madhusudan Dutt, an ardent admirer of both European and Indian literature, drew inspiration from Milton, Tasso, Homer, Virgil, Valmiki, Vyasa, and Kalidasa for this epic.  The poem is divided into nine cantos, each depicting different events. It begins with the death of Beerbahu, Ravana's son, and concludes with the sati-daha (the ancient Indian custom of burning widows alive with their deceased husbands) of Prameela, Meghnad's beloved wife.
